rules.base: lane A = v5/levels/core.v0_candidates (pdh/pdl, onh/onl, orh/orl from 10:00; 09:45-15:00 ET; 1 tick through + close back; one signal per level per day), book = ABSORBED (OF1 zone 8 ticks, |dz| >= 0.20 vz against the push) AND the flag, one position at a time
rules.entry: E5 coarse (levels/core.simulate): open beyond level = fill at open; else >=1 tick through = fill at level; else stop in bar = no fill; else next open + 18 ticks
rules.stop: 1 tick beyond signal bar extreme; stop fill 2 ticks worse
rules.AT: t15 == d and t60 == d; tN = sign(EMA21 - EMA50) of clock-aligned closed N-minute bars (tools/retail_standalone htf/to5)
rules.LA: LIT Market levels of the trading day on the fade side, first breach within 24 bars ending at the signal bar, depth >= 0.5 x ATR14(5m)
rules.S1: previous session rv20 ((H-L)/C 20-session mean) > its trailing 252-session median (min 120)
rules.VX: last VIX close before the session day > trailing 252-session median (min 120)
rules.IO: 09:30 bar open strictly inside prior usable day's RTH high-low
rules.VOTE: >= 3 of AT, LA, S1, VX, IO
rules.placebo: flag shuffle over resolved absorbed candidates; day-level for S1/VX/IO; 5000; Holm over the frozen set
rules.pass_bar: YES-candidate: >=20 trades, net>0, PF>=1.2, both halves meanR>0 and gap>0, placebo p<0.10, Holm<0.10
